jyutping: ling6 A tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3

english.note: Use this construction when the emphasis is on causing someone to become vigilant rather than simply frightening them.

examples.english: This scam can alarm me into becoming more vigilant.
examples.traditional: 呢單騙案令我提高警覺。
examples.jyutping: ni1 daan1 pin3 on3 ling6 ngo5 tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3
